notes: UNVERIFIED (research 2026-07-03): no baptismal, immigration, or land record was found for a Benjamin (C.) Groff under any spelling (Groff, Graff, Groof, De Groff). The ~65-year gap to his son Samuel Joel Groff's birth (c. 1695) is unusually wide for one father/son step; this may reflect an elderly father, a wrong/rounded birth year, or a missing intermediate generation. No source found resolves which. Note also that documented colonial 'Groff' families are overwhelmingly the Lancaster Co., PA Mennonite Graeff/Groff line (immigrant Hans Graeff, c. 1717) — a distinct family; if this Salem/Gloucester/Burlington Co., NJ Groff family is real, it predates and is unconnected to that immigration.
